decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API directly builds on the firm's existing cloud messaging, API, and integration expertise, so its absorptive capacity is high and the product's continued presence on the website signals it is being assimilated and improved.

The email-to-SMS gateway extends the firm's secured email and messaging capabilities, closely matching its existing knowledge base, so the firm can interpret early results and refine the product rather than drop it.
The SMS-to-email gateway leverages the firm's experience in messaging, document capture, and archiving, giving it the related knowledge to absorb and improve the product, making withdrawal unlikely.
